name: postnilo
description: Prepare media, drafts and confirmed social reservations, with recurring posts and Instagram automations in your connected Postnilo workspace.

interface.longDescription: Prepare and manage posts for supported social channels in Postnilo. Browse connected channels and media, upload images or videos, and save individual or batch drafts. Review the content, destination channels, posting times, and platform-specific settings before scheduling. Manage recurring reservations, inspect results, cancel reservations, and manage Instagram comment-to-DM automations. Actions depend on connected accounts and platform access.
defaultPrompt: Show my connected channels and ready media.
Help me upload a video and save a draft.
Show my upcoming reservations and their channel times.

positive.description: Connect and read the authorized review workspace and channels.
positive.prompt: Show my Postnilo account and connected YouTube channels.
positive.expected_behavior: Using the dedicated sample account, show the actual Postnilo login email and connected YouTube channel cards with their real profile photos. Mark17 is connected. Add one short sentence unless the user requests more detail. Existing authorization may be reused; do not expose internal IDs or permissions unless requested. Read only; do not create or change posts.

positive.description: Select a ready library video and save an unscheduled private YouTube draft.
positive.prompt: Use postnilo-youtube-private-test.mp4 from my library to save a YouTube draft titled My first video. Keep it private and not made for kids, and show me the saved draft.
positive.expected_behavior: Use only a ready media ID and the confirmed YouTube channel, title, private visibility and audience setting. Read back the same draft ID with no scheduled time.

positive.description: Upload a local MP4 through the widget and save a separate unscheduled draft. Before running this case, open Media in the Postnilo reviewer workspace and play Postnilo-Claude-review-sample.mp4. From the video player’s three-dot menu, choose Download. Name the downloaded copy postnilo-review-upload-sample.mp4 and use it in the upload widget.
positive.prompt: I want to upload postnilo-review-upload-sample.mp4 from my computer. Help me save it as a separate YouTube draft titled New upload, private and not made for kids. Show me the saved draft.
positive.tools_triggered: channels_list, upload_open, mcp_upload_begin, mcp_upload_complete, upload_status, platform_settings, draft_save, post_get
positive.expected_behavior: The widget handles its app-only upload tools. Save only the verified ready media ID and read back the separate draft without scheduling or publication.

positive.description: Create a new draft within this case, schedule that same private YouTube draft, inspect it and cancel it on request.
positive.prompt: Use postnilo-youtube-private-test.mp4 from my library to create a new YouTube draft titled Channel update. Keep it private and not made for kids. Then help me schedule that draft for 11 AM Korea time three days from now.
positive.tools_triggered: channels_list, media_list, platform_settings, draft_save, post_get, draft_schedule, posts_list, post_cancel, post_get
positive.expected_behavior: This case is self-contained: create its own new draft from the prepared ready sample and connected Mark17 YouTube channel; do not depend on another test case or reuse a previously canceled post. Resolve the relative date to the exact Asia/Seoul date/time at least 48 hours ahead. Show the channel, video, title, private visibility, audience setting and YouTube upload notice before scheduling, and obtain confirmation of those actual details. Reuse exact unchanged approval. Schedule the newly created draft once. The reviewer then asks Show my upcoming reservations, followed immediately by Cancel the reservation we just made and show me the result. List the exact new reservation, cancel only that post using its current version, and read back the same ID with resultStatus and YouTube target status canceled. Do not claim a YouTube upload or publication. If any response is lost or cancellation is unconfirmed, read the same ID and stop additional scheduling. For the YouTube notice, request platform_settings with purpose=upload_confirmation and the user’s language and device; show that one notice in the same confirmation. Requirements-only lookup and access-removal guidance are separate purposes.

positive.description: Create one separate reservation through direct scheduling, list it, then cancel that exact future reservation.
positive.prompt: Use postnilo-youtube-private-test.mp4 from my library for a new reservation on my connected YouTube channel titled Next video at noon Korea time three days from now. Keep it private and not made for kids.
positive.tools_triggered: channels_list, media_list, platform_settings, post_schedule, posts_list, post_get, post_cancel, post_get
positive.expected_behavior: This case starts from the prepared ready library sample and connected Mark17 YouTube channel; it does not require another positive case. Resolve the relative date to the exact Asia/Seoul date/time at least 48 hours ahead. Show the channel, video, title, private visibility, audience setting and YouTube upload notice and obtain confirmation of the actual details. Reuse exact unchanged approval. Create one direct private future reservation with one stable request key. The reviewer then asks Show my upcoming reservations, followed immediately by Cancel the reservation we just made and show me the result. Identify the newly returned post in the list, cancel only that post using its current version and read back the same ID with resultStatus and YouTube target status canceled. Do not modify earlier cases or existing posts, or claim publication. After response loss, reuse the same request key and payload or read the returned post ID instead of creating a new reservation. Stop additional scheduling if cancellation is unconfirmed. For the YouTube notice, request platform_settings with purpose=upload_confirmation and the user’s language and device; show that one notice in the same confirmation. Requirements-only lookup and access-removal guidance are separate purposes.

negative.description: Missing scheduling details. Start a fresh chat with the plugin available and no prior exact time or audience choice. The plugin should clarify before creating a reservation.
negative.prompt: Schedule postnilo-youtube-private-test.mp4 on my YouTube channel tomorrow morning. I have not chosen the exact time for this video yet.
negative.expected_behavior: Necessary read-only lookups may find the ready sample, connected channel and required YouTube settings. Ask for the exact time and any other missing required title or audience setting together. Do not invent a time, audience or approval, create a reservation or silently substitute a draft. Reuse values already established in actual context rather than asking again. No write should occur while required details are unresolved.

negative.description: Past scheduling time. Start a fresh chat; November 3, 2026 at 11 AM Korea time is already past when recording on or after November 4, 2026.
negative.prompt: Schedule postnilo-youtube-private-test.mp4 from my Postnilo library on Mark17 for November 3, 2026 at 11 AM Korea time. Title it Past time test. Keep it private and not made for kids.
negative.expected_behavior: Report that the requested scheduling time is in the past. Ask for a future time or propose one and wait for the user to choose. Do not silently move the date, publish immediately, save a fallback draft or create a reservation. Necessary read-only lookups are allowed. The reviewer does not answer the follow-up and ends this scene without a write.

negative.description: Unconnected destination with complete scheduling details. Start a fresh chat in the prepared sample workspace, where Mark17 is connected and Team Updates is not connected.
negative.prompt: Schedule postnilo-youtube-private-test.mp4 on the Team Updates YouTube channel for 11 AM Korea time three days from now. Title it Team update. Keep it private and not made for kids.
negative.expected_behavior: Verify the connected channels and report that Team Updates is not connected in this workspace. Do not infer that the user cannot own or manage that channel. Explain how to connect it with an authorized account, or ask the user to explicitly choose another connected destination. Do not substitute Mark17 or another channel, invent channel IDs, save a draft, create a reservation, cancel a post, upload media, or start OAuth. Other necessary read-only lookups are allowed. If Team Updates is actually connected, this negative fixture is no longer valid; do not force a refusal of an otherwise valid request.

review.commerce_description: Access to existing Postnilo entitlements only. This plugin does not sell subscriptions, promote upgrades or initiate checkout.

publication.release_notes: Version 0.1.3 exposes Postnilo’s existing 45-tool MCP workflow (43 model tools and 2 upload-widget tools) through the existing ChatGPT and Claude OAuth clients. The workflow uses the capabilities available to connected accounts while preserving the review posts_list pagination contract, OAuth endpoints, and scopes. All tool metadata and input fixtures are validated separately from the five positive and three negative live recording cases. Negative case 2 now checks a past scheduling time.

ko-KR.subtitle: 대화에서 SNS 예약과 결과 확인
ko-KR.description: Postnilo에서 지원하는 소셜 채널의 게시물을 준비하고 관리하세요. 연결된 채널과 미디어를 조회하고, 이미지나 영상을 업로드해 개별·일괄 초안을 저장하세요. 게시할 내용, 채널, 시간과 플랫폼별 설정을 확인한 뒤 예약하세요. 반복 예약·결과 조회·취소와 Instagram 댓글 자동 DM도 관리할 수 있습니다. 연결 계정과 플랫폼 접근 조건에 따라 사용할 수 있는 기능이 달라집니다.
